job.title: Partnerships & Project Coordinator
job.city: Melbourne CBD & Inner Suburbs Melbourne VIC
job.description:
Lets start with whats in it for you!

  • An opportunity to work within a highly regarded NFP organisation that changes the lives of young Australians
  • Work across partnerships, procurement, administration and large-scale event logistics
  • CBD location with lots of work from home flexibility
  • Monday - Friday, permanent position
  • 38 hour week with flexible start/finish times
  • Work on national events with thousands of attendees
  • Attractive salary on offer
  • Friendly and social culture with all hands on deck
  • Versatile role with opportunity to develop


The Company
Our client is a well-established events organisation providing unique opportunities to the youth of Australia. With a global network spanning 85 countries and numerous industries, our client develops programs that showcase young peoples skills and talents which can ultimately shape their future and change their lives.


The Role
Reporting to the Head of Partnerships, this varied position will take ownership of procurement, sourcing and product-in-kind partnerships for major national events. Additionally, you will coordinate partnership administration, stakeholder engagement and the delivery of partner rights and benefits.

Your responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

  • Support the maintenance of strong relationships with existing corporate partners, sponsors and suppliers
  • Coordinate partnership rights and benefits, ensuring all administrative deliverables are fulfilled ahead of events
  • Collaborate with the Head of Partnerships to prepare proposals, agreements, contracts and partner communications
  • Maintain accurate partner records, contracts, CRM data and payment schedules
  • Work closely with the Operations team to source products, equipment and services required for national events
  • Procure and coordinate product-in-kind sponsorships, donations and supplier contributions
  • Support stakeholder recognition activities, event logistics and on-the-day event delivery


As the ideal candidate you will have:

  • Experience in Partnerships, Contract Administration, Sponsorship, Account Management, Stakeholder Engagement or Relationship Management
  • Experience coordinating procurement, sourcing and suppliers
  • Strong administration skills with experience managing contracts, CRM systems, reporting or stakeholder records
  • The ability to build and maintain strong relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and a proactive nature
  • Drive and the ability to HAVE FUN!

  • Liaise with clients, property agents and government departments via phone and email

Please apply now to join this people focused organisation. Interviews will take place immediately - good luck!

job.title: Assistant Accountant
job.description:
What's in it for you?

  • Work in modern offices for a startup agricultural organisation that looks after their people - be part of the journey!
  • Very attractive salary on offer depending on experience
  • Full time, Monday - Friday, 9am - 5pm
  • Work from home flexibility
  • Central location, close to cafes & shops
  • Varied role – with a mix of AR/AP & assistant accountant duties
  • Opportunity to take ownership of the finance operations across Australia and New Zealand
  • Strong mentorship and career development opportunities
  • Very fun and social culture with great company perks such as plenty of free breakies, snacks and lunches, networking events and social activities
  • ASAP start


The Company

An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Assistant Accountant to join this dynamic and thriving agricultural company who are located in the heart of Melbourne CBD. Their office is close to restaurants, cafes and retail shops. With a focus on mentorship and valuing input, the company promotes a professional and enjoyable work culture.


The Role

Reporting into the CFO, you will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day financial operations of the business across it's Australian and New Zealand entities.

This is a hands-on and varied role with ownership of the end-to-end Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable functions, alongside exposure to Assistant Accountant responsibilities. You'll work closely with the finance team ensuring the smooth running of both ledgers.

Your responsibilities will include but not limited to:

  • Manage end-to-end Accounts Payable and Receivable across AU and NZ
  • Process high-volume invoices, purchase orders, payment runs and reconciliations using Xero
  • Manage customer invoicing, credit notes, payment allocations and debtor collections
    Manage supplier and customer queries, building strong relationships
  • Prepare month-end journals, accruals, prepayments and bank reconciliations
  • Complete balance sheet and intercompany reconciliations, and maintain the fixed asset register
  • Assist with GST/BAS, NZ GST returns, month-end reporting and audits
  • Identify process improvements and utilise AI and technology to streamline finance operations


What do I need to be successful?

  • Proven experience in a high-volume assistant accountant/financial administration position with a strong understanding of AR/AP processes
  • Exposure to Assistant Accountant responsibilities, including reconciliations, journals and month-end processes
  • Strong ERP systems proficiency, specifically Xero and ApprovalMax
  • Advanced Excel skills, including reconciliations and reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial processes, controls and best practices
  • High level of accuracy, attention to detail and data entry skills
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, work autonomously and consistently meet deadlines
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, coupled with a can-do attitude and genuine desire to contribute to a positive team culture

job.title: Recruitment Operations Lead
job.city: Melbourne CBD & Inner Suburbs Melbourne VIC
job.description:
LOVE tech, process and people? Eager to shape how a boutique agency works behind the scenes and out front?

Then look no further….

  • Own our recruitment technology, from ATS and CRM, through to automation and system rollouts
  • Hands on Operations role - working with the Director and Recruitment Manager
  • Part time or full position, with flexibility for start/finish times
  • CBD location with WFH flexibility after the probation period
  • Attractive salary package on offer
  • Work in a fun, dynamic culture
  • Morning teas, lunches and company events & activities
  • Learning and professional development opportunities


About Us

Hugo Personnel is an Australian owned and managed, corporate recruitment agency. We work alongside our sister company, Inter Staffing Services, to provide temporary and permanent staff to our exceptional partners. We recruit in the areas of finance and accounting, administration and office support, call centre and customer service, human resources, and marketing and communications.

Our office is located right in the heart of the CBD, very close to public transport, with work from home flexibility after the probation period.


The Role

Reporting to the Director and Recruitment Manager, you will be the champion user of our core recruitment systems. You will review and refine our tech stack, lead rollouts and training, keep our data clean and compliant, and bring the team along for the ride. You will also draw on your recruitment knowledge to support our consultants, step in on escalations and occasionally recruit senior roles.

Your main responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Review and refine the company tech stack, lead system rollouts and integrations
  • Act as champion user and first point of contact for all recruitment systems
  • Analyse recruitment processes and workflows, and find opportunities for automation and optimisation
  • Facilitate onboarding and training for new and existing staff, including the leadership team
  • Refine training collateral, automation templates and instructional design packages
  • Assist with internal recruitment for new team members
  • Maintain data hygiene and produce ATS reports
  • Support weekly social media content, create EDMs, nurture pathways and marketing analytics
  • Support the Recruitment Manager with higher duties, senior role recruitment and client escalations
  • Collaborate with the Directors, IT Manager and Payroll Manager to manage our software vendors

What you need to succeed?

  • Demonstrated experience in an agency environement
  • Proven experience rolling out a CRM, ATS or HRIS
  • Demonstrated experience as a Senior Recruiter and/ or Operations Team Lead
  • Strong working knowledge of an ATS and CRM, including automation builders or APIs, and the confidence to train others
  • Strong influencing skills, with the ability to bring stakeholders into change
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience facilitating workshops and training for staff at all levels
  • Sound understanding of compliance in a recruitment settings
  • Ability to adapt when priorities change, including balancing the needs of two businesses
  • Understanding of marketing and brand awareness (not essential)

Come join our close knit and energetic team who work hard but also have a lot of fun and laughs along the way.

Interviews will be held immediately.

job.title: Recruitment Administrator
job.description:
Are you an experienced Recruitment Administrator/Coordinator eager to develop your career in a purpose driven organisation?

What’s in it for you?

  • Work for a community-focused not for profit making a real impact across Victoria
  • 2.5 month temporary role with opportunity for extension
  • Work-life flexibility with 4 days WFH, 1 day in the office (Wednesdays)
  • Avoid the CBD - Footscray head office with free car parking available
  • Mentorship and continuous learning opportunities available
  • Supportive and inclusive culture
  • WHV holders welcome to apply!


The Company

Join a progressive, forward thinking community organisation committed to increased allied health outcomes across the state. This is a workplace that genuinely values balance, flexibility, and professional growth, while maintaining a strong focus on delivering positive and impactful services to the community.

The Role

Reporting to the Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will be responsible for providing administrative and operational support across a broad range of HR and recruitment matters.

Additionally, you will:

  • Process employee documentation including contracts, onboarding, position descriptions, and database maintenance
  • Respond to and resolve HR Helpdesk tickets within agreed timeframes.
  • Assist hiring managers with end to end recruitment and staff coordination - phone screening, shortlisting, compliance and reference checks
  • Coordinate job advertising across multiple recruitment platforms and ensure posting accuracy.
  • Maintain the administration and maintenance of recruitment records, employee documentation and associated approval processes.
  • Complete regular reporting to support industrial agreement implementation
  • Build strong relationships with hiring managers to identify workforce needs and provide advice on hiring strategies and compliance requirements
  • Contribute to continuous improvement across HR quality, workforce operations and compliance frameworks


What will I need to succeed?

  • Proven experience in an Internal Recruitment Coordinator role or HR Administrator role
  • Strong understanding of employment legislation and Award/Agreement interpretation
  • Proven experience with systems including Dayforce (desirable)
  • WWCC and Police Check required for the role
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion
  • A positive, proactive self-starter with a “can do” attitude
